beats.label: Try the recipe's rotate command
beats.cue: “Exit 1, and the reason is the honest one: an env-var backend will not invent key material. Wire the file backend from recipe 20 and this is where onRotation fires.”
beats.script: Exit 1, and the reason is the honest one: an env-var backend will not invent key material. Wire the file backend from recipe 20 and this is where onRotation fires. [[pause:1.5s]] The nonzero result is intentional: this command expects exit code 1. Deliberate rejection exit 1: 'secret "CREWHAUS_AUDIT_KEK" cannot be rotated via env-var backend without a newValue'.

verify.note: deliberate rejection — exit 1: 'secret "CREWHAUS_AUDIT_KEK" cannot be rotated via env-var backend without a newValue'. No secrets backend is configured in a scratch driver dir, so the deployment falls back to env vars; the recipe's rotation flow needs the file backend (recipe 20) or --value.
